title: Mission Basilica San Juan Capistrano

buildingCutout.basis: Replaces only the high-overlap mapped footprint of the current basilica; nearby mission property stays visible.

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged bare-earth grade in the forecourt immediately northwest of the main portal.

mapIdentity.provider: Named and surveyed OpenStreetMap exterior of Mission Basilica San Juan Capistrano
mapIdentity.scope: The standing Mission Basilica is named in the surveyed 18-point OpenStreetMap outline at 31520 Camino Capistrano. Its mapped body height is 17.04 m. The facade and tower occupy the northwest end of the footprint, across the forecourt from Camino Capistrano.

note: The parish confirms the 1986 completion. The architect’s contemporary description and published architectural survey support the long cross-shaped nave and cupola. Cleared Qualla images establish the white Mission Revival silhouette, ornate facade and two stacked octagonal belfries with terracotta roof.
